recipes.name: Jjajangbap (Blackbean sauce over rice: 짜장밥)
ingredients: ¼ cup chunjang (Korean black bean paste)
8 ounces onion (1 large onion), chopped coarsely
1 pound pork shoulder (or pork belly), cut into ½ inch cubes
Freshly made cooked rice (see how to make rice
instructions: Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 6 to 7 minutes.
Stir in the starch water. Drizzle the sesame oil over top and remove from the heat.
Put some hot rice on a plate or bowl and ladle the sauce on top. Serve by itself, or with kimchi.
